subject: craft
angle: How a debut invitation should differ from a wedding one
caption:
Weddings ask for neutral tones, but an 18th birthday lets you play with richer ink and heavier craft paper.

· Thicker cardstock gives a debut invite more weight
· Bold ink stands out against natural craft paper
· Save formal layout rules for your ninangs later
· Include a simple QR code for guest responses
